question.zh: 贾斯珀·怀特的问题是什么？

sentences.zh: 贾斯珀·怀特的问题是什么？

sentences.en: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths.
sentences.zh: 贾斯珀·怀特是少有的相信古代神话的人之一。

sentences.en: He has just bought a new house in the city, but ever since he moved in, he has had trouble with cars and their owners.
sentences.zh: 他刚在城里买了一所新房子，但自从搬进去后，就和汽车及车主们发生了摩擦。

sentences.en: When he returns home at night, he always finds that someone has parked a car outside his gate.
sentences.zh: 他晚上回家时，总是发现有人把车停在他家大门外。

sentences.en: Because of this, he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
sentences.zh: 为此，他甚至一次也没能把车开进自己的车库。

sentences.en: Jasper has put up 'No Parking' signs outside his gate, but these have not had any effect.
sentences.zh: 贾斯珀在大门外挂上了“禁止停车”的牌子，但毫无效果。

sentences.en: Now he has put an ugly stone head over the gate.
sentences.zh: 现在他在大门上方放了一个丑陋的石头头像。

sentences.en: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这是我见过的最丑陋的面孔之一。

sentences.en: I asked him what it was and he told me that it was Medusa, the Gorgon.
sentences.zh: 我问他这是什么，他告诉我这是蛇发女怪美杜莎。

sentences.en: Jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone.
sentences.zh: 贾斯珀希望她把汽车和车主都变成石头。

sentences.en: But none of them has been turned to stone yet!
sentences.zh: 但至今还没有一个人变成石头！
